description: This is a Spring Framework Java controller class for managing course-related HTTP endpoints in a web application. It handles CRUD operations for 'Curso' entities, interacts with repositories and services, and manages access control via annotations.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling HTTP requests related to 'Curso' entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and viewing course details, with role-based access control.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show a form for adding a new course associated with a professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new course for a specified professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a course for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing course.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET requests to delete a course by ID.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display details of a specific course, including whether the authenticated user is enrolled.
